text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe conquered the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), inheriting Zenno Rob Roy's dream 
of the Autumn Senior Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If it's just like the other universe, the 
"Great King" and the "Singularity" will 
soon appear. To counter them, we need to 
push each other even higher.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Hishi Miracle, her rival who had 
competed alongside her all this time, 
suggests that maybe it's fine to just run 
"for fun now."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True, if it's about broadening 
"connections"... it might be nice to run 
the Japan Cup with "a bit more fun."
